title: Agent keys
summary: Let programs on this computer, such as AI agents, read and write records here through Observanda's agent API.
help: An agent key lets a program on this computer, such as an AI agent from any provider, read and write records in this workspace through Observanda's agent API. A key works only while this workspace, and the project or lab book it reaches, is unlocked here. Revoke a key as soon as it is no longer needed.
name: Name
nameHint: Name the program or agent that will use the key.
allLabBooks: All lab books in the project
revoked: The agent key no longer works.
shownOnce: This key is shown only once. Copy it now and give it to the program that will use it. Anyone with the key can use its access while this workspace is unlocked.
descriptionHelp: The program learns how to use the agent API from this address, served by this Observanda.
endpointFileHelp: Observanda's address changes each time it starts. Programs on this computer read the current address and description from this file.
